name: Acceptance voice mode
description: The acceptance run's second speaking plugin, installed from a folder: it speaks through a background part of its own, which takes the device's speech turn (device/speech) before it sounds, so it never talks over MOSS Voice. It fills MOSS Voice's modes point (one at a time, titled Voice): picked in Settings it is the voice, says each reply its own way (a tone) and writes down push-to-talk as words that say how many bytes reached it. Its commands: `chime` has its part play a short tone, `report` says what it said, what it heard and when it held the turn.

commands.name: chime
commands.description: Has its background part play a short tone, in the device's speech turn.

commands.name: report
commands.description: What it said, and the spans its part held the device's speech turn.
